requirements.quote: When saving an API request to a collection, click the Modify with AI icon ( .⟡+ ) next to the request name field to have the system automatically assign a name based on the request's context and properties.
requirements.statement: User can click the Modify with AI icon next to the request name field to have the system automatically name a request when saving it to a collection.

requirements.quote: Specify the authorization, headers, and variables that all nested requests or folders should adhere to.
requirements.statement: User can specify authorization, headers, and variables for nested requests and folders in collection properties.

requirements.quote: To add a new request to your collection, you can click on the "Save" button on the request page and select the collection you want to add it to.
requirements.statement: User can add a request to a collection by clicking Save on the request page and selecting the collection.

requirements.quote: The AI Assistant is an experimental chat assistant that can act on the request, response, environment, and collections you're working with.
requirements.statement: User can use the AI Assistant, an experimental chat assistant, to act on the request, response, environment, and collections they are working with.

requirements.quote: Generate API documentation from your Collections
requirements.section: API Documentation > What you can do
requirements.statement: User can generate API documentation from their Collections

requirements.quote: You can create a mock server from scratch or from an existing Collection.
requirements.section: API Mocking > Create a mock server
requirements.statement: User can create a mock server from scratch or from an existing Collection.

requirements.quote: Right-click on a collection or a subfolder within a collection to open its properties.
requirements.section: Authorization > Managing Authorization at the Collection Level
requirements.statement: User can right-click a collection or subfolder to open its properties.

requirements.quote: You can create collections and add requests to them to share with your team or to use later.
requirements.statement: User can create collections and add requests to them to share with the team or use later.

requirements.quote: You can access the collections by clicking the "Collections" icon on the side panel.
requirements.statement: User can access collections by clicking the Collections icon on the side panel.

requirements.quote: To create a new collection, click on the "Add new" button on the collections section and enter the name of the collection.
requirements.statement: User can create a new collection by clicking Add new in the collections section and entering a name.

requirements.quote: You can also create a sub-collection by clicking on the "Add new" button on the desired collection and entering the name of the sub-collection.
requirements.statement: User can create a sub-collection by clicking Add new on a collection and entering a name.

requirements.quote: You can organize your collections by dragging and dropping them to the desired location.
requirements.statement: User can organize collections by dragging and dropping them to the desired location.

requirements.quote: You can also create sub-collections by dragging and dropping a collection into another collection.
requirements.statement: User can create sub-collections by dragging and dropping a collection into another collection.

requirements.quote: To add a request to a collection, click on the "New request" button on the collection's options to save the current request to the collection.
requirements.section: Collections > Organizing collections > Adding requests to collections
requirements.statement: User can add the current request to a collection with the New request button in the collection's options.

requirements.quote: Click on the drop-down menu next to the save button and click on "Save as" to save the request to a new location.
requirements.statement: User can save a request to a new location using Save as from the drop-down next to the Save button.

requirements.quote: Right-click on the collection and select the "Run Collection" option.
requirements.statement: User can right-click a collection and select the "Run Collection" option.

requirements.quote: Alternatively, hover over the collection name and click on the "Run Collection" icon.
requirements.statement: User can hover over a collection name and click the "Run Collection" icon.

requirements.quote: Run all requests in a Hoppscotch collection sequentially with configurable delays, iterations, and environment variables using the Runner.
requirements.statement: User can run all requests in a collection sequentially with the Runner, configuring delays, iterations and environment variables.

requirements.quote: Persist Responses: Log response headers and bodies for review after running the collection.
requirements.statement: User can persist response headers and bodies for review after running the collection.

requirements.quote: Stop Run if Error Occurs: The collection run stops if an error is encountered within a script or if there's a problem sending a request.
requirements.statement: User can have the collection run stop if a script error or request sending problem occurs.
